visualCharacteristics.description: 50/50 split, image cell fills its half edge-to-edge at full viewport height (object-fit cover, no radius), text half on the page background with uppercase bold h3 + body paragraphs. Image side follows cell order (image-left and image-right both used).

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: [image] | [heading + paragraphs] or [heading + paragraphs] | [image]; cell order sets the image side
